acceptance: Two real host versions, real tool calls, cross-session results, all with evidence files. No SDK test process counts as a host product.

setup.shared_scope_note: Both clients bind their own scope; the handover record is written under a shared project scope 'export-format' via a third, shared binding, or the receiving client reads the brief produced by the first client. The fixture uses the shared project scope.

steps_a: Start a fresh session in client A. Remember: requirement 'export.format' = 'zip with manifest.json + SHA256SUMS' (source: user_statement).
begin task 'produce export manifest'; finish with key 'export.manifest' = draft manifest (idempotency key 'export-a-1').
Write a handoff brief (turnkeep brief tool) with the decision, the evidence record ids, and the next step: 'verify the manifest against the frozen source tree'.
steps_b: Close client A completely. Start a fresh session in client B (no context copied by hand).
recall 'export format' and read the brief; resume the run from A.
Verify the manifest against the frozen tree; if the requirement changed, the old finish must be rejected (STALE_SNAPSHOT) — re-read and fix, then finish with a new run.
Record the real tool-call log (client's own session log) and the client version.
steps_reverse: Repeat A->B in the other direction (B changes the requirement, A must re-read after a stale finish).
title: Two-client handover: export format decision
